svg.title: cuML CART tree, chess 1M, depth limit 10
svg.text: Gini on 128 histogram bins (CART-like) · hopper (NVIDIA H100 PCIe) · cuML 26.10.00
chess 3x3, 1M rows (80/20) · no pruning · timed: RandomForestClassifier.fit from the host float32 arrays (copy, binning, growing), after a warm-up fit
run: RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=1, bootstrap=False, max_features=1.0, split_criterion='gini', max_depth=10, n_bins=128)
check: the drawn tree predicts all 200,000 test rows as cuML's own predict() does
left branch: the condition holds (yes). Hover a node for its numbers.
